blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The House of Representatives adopted a congressional resolution on Tuesday posthumously honoring student and scout Chris Lorenz Fabian, praising his courage in shielding fellow students during a June school shooting in Tacloban City. Lawmakers passed by voice vote House Resolution No. 1464 to commend Fabian’s “extraordinary bravery” in securing the door of his classroom as two assailants opened fire at San Jose National High School on June 22. Two teenagers armed with pistols opened fire at their high school, killing three students, including Fabian, and wounding 20 others.
